_doc: Feature switches for build_from_md.py. Per document: HEADERDATA 'features: a=on, b=off, c=0.8'. Per run: PP_FEATURES=/path.json. Edit with pp_features_dashboard.html.

limit_bars.label: Limit bars
limit_bars.help: [[LIMITS]] tables: value + colour bar against its acceptance limit in every cell

limit_bars_amber_at.label: Amber threshold
limit_bars_amber_at.help: Bar length (fraction of the limit) above which a bar turns amber

option_grid.label: Option grids
option_grid.help: A table whose cells are ☐/☒ options is drawn as a tick-box grid

zebra_rows.label: Zebra rows
zebra_rows.help: Alternate row shading in data tables

label_column.label: Label column
label_column.help: First column of a data table shaded as a label column

header_repeat.label: Repeat header row
header_repeat.help: A table's header row repeats on every page it crosses

keep_tables.label: Keep tables together
keep_tables.help: Short tables are kept on one page with their lead-in text
